turnaround_reason: Stock is down ~66% from its 52-week high after management cut FY2026 revenue guidance to ~$850M (from ~$975M) on coding/reimbursement uncertainty tied to the WISeR program, with Q1 growth decelerating to just 1.6% y/y from a historical 20%+ pace.
bullish_points: Still profitable with 85.8% gross margins and 14.3% net margin; $284M cash vs only $30M debt
Q1 2026 beat on EPS (0.10 vs 0.06 est.) despite the guidance cut, showing underlying demand isn't collapsing
Net insider buying over trailing 6 months (210k shares net purchased vs only ~4k sold)
Freedom Capital initiated a Buy, arguing LivaNova/Nyxoah competition is undifferentiated and Inspire keeps category leadership
Trailing PE of 11.3x is cheap for a company with 85%+ gross margins if growth reaccelerates
bearish_points: Guidance implies growth collapsing to ~8% for the year — a severe deceleration from historical norms, and management flagged headwinds persisting through 2026
LivaNova just won FDA approval for a direct competing hypoglossal nerve stimulation device (Aura6000); Nyxoah also advancing toward market
GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are a real long-term overhang on OSA device demand that isn't going away
Forward PE (38.9x) is far above trailing PE, meaning the Street expects a near-term earnings air pocket
Recent officer/director sales, even if small, add no conviction signal on top of an already-cut guide
catalyst: Q2 earnings print — the market's first real read on whether the promised H2 sequential recovery from the coding/reimbursement issue is materializing
suggested_trade: Small starter spot position only; skip options given thin OI (88 calls / 100 puts total) and wait for the Aug 3 print to size up or cut
key_risk: Guidance gets cut again and reimbursement/coding uncertainty extends past 2026, compounding with real competitive share loss to LivaNova
would_skip_if: Q2 print shows growth still decelerating sequentially rather than stabilizing, or LivaNova reports early commercial traction
